name: facebookresearch_imagenet-adversarial-training/third_party/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_imagenet-adversarial-tr.build_augmentor: build a training or validation image augmentor list using fbresnet_augmentor for BGR images
facebookresearch_imagenet-adversarial-tr.create_val_dataflow: create a multi-threaded validation dataflow from an ImageNet directory with batching and augmentation
facebookresearch_imagenet-adversarial-tr.run_evaluation: run evaluation on ILSVRC12 validation data to measure top1 error and attack success rate
facebookresearch_imagenet-adversarial-tr.build_imagenet_model: build a subclass of ImageNetModel to define a custom ImageNet classification model with logits
facebookresearch_imagenet-adversarial-tr.refactor_loss_computation: refactor the compute_loss_and_error method to customize cross-entropy loss and top-k error tracking

facebookresearch_imagenet-adversarial-tr.run_serve_data: run the serve-data script to serve ImageNet training data over ZMQ with a specified batch size
facebookresearch_imagenet-adversarial-tr.run_serve_data_fake: run the serve-data script with fake data to test the ZMQ dataflow pipeline without real ImageNet data
facebookresearch_imagenet-adversarial-tr.run_serve_data_benchmark: run the serve-data script in benchmark mode to measure data loading speed with a warmup period
facebookresearch_imagenet-adversarial-tr.run_serve_data_no_zmq_ops: run the serve-data script without zmq_ops format to serve raw data over ZMQ IPC
facebookresearch_imagenet-adversarial-tr.review_get_data: review the get_data function that builds an augmented batched ImageNet dataflow with ZMQ prefetching
